profile.headline: Software Developer Manager at Point Blank Enterprises, Inc.
profile.summary: Over ten years solid experience as software developer. Excellent organizational and project management skills and detail oriented. Proven ability to work well under pressure and with limited supervision. Well-developed communication skills that build lasting client and company relationships.

positions.title: C# / SQL Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain Web and Windows Applications.
- Develop database design specifications, prototypes, standards and procedures (analysis and design).
- Develop Microsoft Dynamics AX integrations with In-House systems.
- Analyze, test, resolve, and/or define root cause of problems.
- Respond to and resolve production problems and user inquiries.
- Function with business staff and manager to define requirements.
- Develop software code and associated lifecycle deliverables.
- Responsible for documenting code and projects.
- Develop procedures and operating instructions, and successfully move programs into production.
- Maintain application environments.
- Develop interfaces that are easy to understand and display information for edit/view effectively.

positions.title: Computer Analyst
positions.description: Test and observe the use of systems to ensure proper performance. Coordinate software development with the programmers teams. Solve computer problems and use computer technology to meet the needs of the company. Planning for the insertion of a new products with a different technology and a new development platform. Coordinate that all the external services companies that do the Hardware support and repair have all the necessary. Provide onsite and remote technology consulting services in support projects for company clients.

positions.title: Flex/Flash Developer Analyst
positions.description:
Development in Flex using Universal Mind Cairngorm architecture. Development of Point of Sales application that accommodate to the client needs. Development of application for reporting systems that help them  with daily back-office and bank reconciliations as well as internal and external audits. Knowledge of .NET background for application connection through .NET-based Web Service Using the SOAP protocol. Provide support to the clients. 
	
Responsibilities:

-Communication with users to gather requirements and analyze/address issues.
-Development in Flex.
-Interact with other technology groups as needed.
-Coordinate with users and developers located in different geographic regions.

positions.title: Project Coordinator
positions.description:
Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.


Responsibilities:

•	Creation of site layout/user interface from provided design concepts by using standard HTML/CSS practices.
•	Development of robust and user-friendly PHP-based web applications.
•	Design and creation of relational database schemas.
•	MySQL Server T-SQL development.
•	Implementation of shopping cart with POS for Venezuela and USA website.
•	Routine daily maintenance of existing sites and applications.
•	Lead Search Engine Optimization and Online Marketing Projects; Manage web analytics and reporting of user interaction with websites.
•	Create and design POP Materials, Advertising Campaigns, Marketing Support Materials of any kind.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Development and design of Web sites. Lead Search Engine Optimization and Online Marketing Projects; Manage web analytics and reporting of user interaction with web sites

Responsibilities:

-Design and Development of websites for clients using LAMP software bundle.
-Placement and layout of web site pages given client provided content.
-Development of robust and user-friendly PHP-based web applications.
-Design and creation of relational database schemas.

positions.title: SAP ABAP Junior Consultant
positions.description:
Provide technological support to the clients of the enterprise. Development of programs and reports under SAP platform. Collaboration on the monetary conversion projects for some clients.

Responsibilities:

-Codes SAP modules and complex functions using ABAP programming language. 
-Creates specialized reports for SAP modules using ABAP programming language. 
-Designs forms for SAP modules using SAPscript. 
-Troubleshoots and corrects SAP module problems by using ABAP programming language.  
-Assists in defining technical requirements for on-going systems maintenance and future functionality. 
-Provides technical support to users on matters related to the programming of SAP modules. 
-Prepares comprehensive and thorough technical program documentation including specifications, test conditions, test plans, test data, etc. 
-Trains users on programming of forms and reports, defining authorization roles, custom workflows, and other related areas.

positions.title: Support Analyst
positions.description:
Provide front line IT support to customers/staff. To ensure that calls for support are dealt with promptly and appropriately.

Responsibilities:

-Talking staff/clients through a series of actions, either face to face or over the telephone to help set up systems or resolve issues;
-Troubleshooting system and network problems and diagnosing and solving hardware/software faults
-Providing support, including procedural documentation and relevant reports.
-Following diagrams and written instructions to repair a fault or set up a system.
-Responding within agreed time limits to call-outs;
-Working continuously on a task until completion (or referral to third parties, if appropriate).
-Prioritizing and managing many open cases at one time.
-Rapidly establishing a good working relationship with customers and other professionals, e.g., software developers.
